declared_design: Same ordered expanded game tree across sharing probabilities; fresh table each call; left-to-right; full terminal search.
timing_boundary: Already constructed and validated inputs. Includes fresh table creation, lookup, bound checks, stores and all search. Excludes generation, independent oracle, validation, trace and file output. No concurrent benchmark worker.
interpretation: Exploratory timing on fixed workloads; IQR is descriptive, not confidence. Do not select and independently confirm a parameter in the same data. Object identity is not structural equality; cache lookup never merges equal independent copies.
